request: I want to build an app for my book club. We pick a book each month and everyone leaves a short review with a rating out of five.

operations.intent: Email/password sign in and sign up for club members Works with the Member record described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Sibling pages in this app: Library, Book detail. Follow docs/CONVENTIONS.md; docs/BRIEF.md says what this app deliberately does not do.

Lists all books picked so far by month; where new books get added Works with the Book record described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Sibling pages in this app: Login, Book detail. Follow docs/CONVENTIONS.md; docs/BRIEF.md says what this app deliberately does not do.

Shows one book's info, its reviews, average rating, and lets the logged-in member add their own review Works with the Member and Book and Review records described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Sibling pages in this app: Login, Library. Follow docs/CONVENTIONS.md; docs/BRIEF.md says what this app deliberately does not do.
